facts.text: As a federally recognized work college, Kuyper College requires all residential students to participate in KuyperWorks, integrating classroom learning with work while receiving up to an $8,100 annual reduction in tuition costs.

sources.title: Work College - Kuyper College
sources.quote: Kuyper's commitment to learning, working and serving by requiring all residential students to participate in a comprehensive program which integrates classroom learning with the learning you experience within your workplace, and those you serve.
